name: Beer Lahai Roi
overview: Beer Lahai Roi, also known as Lahai-Roi, is a well mentioned in Genesis that holds significant spiritual meaning. It is described as 'the well of him that liveth and seeth me,' highlighting God's attentive care and provision (Genesis 16:14). This well is geographically situated between Kadesh and Bered and later becomes the dwelling place of Isaac, symbolizing God's ongoing blessing and presence with His people after Abraham's death (Genesis 24:62; 25:11). The references to Beer Lahai Roi emphasize God's sustaining life and watchful presence in the lives of His faithful servants.
